remediation: Remove /encryptionkeys/premium.key from public access, rotate the key, and authorize deluxe upgrades based on server-side payment state rather than a client-submitted shared secret.

finding: Unauthenticated Security Question Disclosure and Email Enumeration
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 / password recovery API:3000
remediation: Return uniform recovery responses, require anti-automation controls, and avoid disclosing recovery questions until the user has passed an appropriate verification step.

finding: Exposed premium key grants deluxe membership without payment
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 deluxe membership workflow:3000
remediation: Remove premium.key from public exposure, rotate it, and verify upgrades server-side with a payment provider rather than a replayable static secret.

finding: Unauthenticated role mass assignment creates admin accounts
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 user registration API:3000
remediation: Apply server-side allowlist binding for registration fields and always assign role=customer on self-registration.

finding: Exposed premium key activates deluxe membership without payment
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 deluxe membership flow:3000
remediation: Remove the public premium key, rotate it, and authorize membership upgrades using server-side purchase/payment records rather than a reusable shared secret.

finding: JWT RS256-to-HS256 Algorithm Confusion Using Exposed Public Key
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 API on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Pin accepted JWT algorithms to RS256, reject HS256 for RSA-key tokens, remove exposed key files from public routes, and rotate the JWT keypair.

finding: Login JWT Payload Exposes Password Hash and Full User Model
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 / JWT session issuance:3000
remediation: Issue minimal JWT claims only, rotate existing tokens, and migrate password storage from unsalted MD5 to a modern password KDF.

finding: Deterministic Textbook RSA Allows Public Decryption of Encrypted Announcement
target: OWASP Juice Shop /ftp announcement encryption artifact on port 3000
remediation: Replace deterministic per-character RSA with randomized RSA-OAEP or hybrid AEAD encryption and rotate/re-encrypt exposed announcements.

finding: Unsigned JWT alg=none accepted for admin API access
target: OWASP Juice Shop / Node.js Express on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Upgrade/secure JWT verification, explicitly allow only the expected signed algorithm, and reject alg=none/untrusted alg headers.

finding: Adjacent Juice Shop accepts unsigned alg=none admin JWT
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0
remediation: Upgrade/fix JWT verification to reject unsigned tokens and validate role claims server-side.

finding: Exposed premium key enables unauthorized deluxe membership upgrade
target: OWASP Juice Shop 6.2.0-SNAPSHOT / deluxe membership API:3000
remediation: Remove public key exposure, rotate the premium key, and replace static-key membership activation with server-side payment/order authorization checks.

finding: Exposed premium.key grants replayable deluxe membership upgrade
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 /encryptionkeys and /rest/deluxe-membership:3000
remediation: Remove /encryptionkeys from public static serving and replace the global premium key with per-user, single-use, expiring redemption codes stored only as hashes server-side.

finding: Login JWT discloses MD5 password hash and full user model
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 authentication service:3000
remediation: Issue minimal JWT claims only; remove password hashes and full ORM records from token payloads and rotate tokens after deploying the fix.

finding: Security question endpoint enables account enumeration and recovery-question disclosure
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 account recovery API:3000
remediation: Return uniform responses for account-recovery lookups, require proof of account control before showing recovery questions, and rate-limit enumeration attempts.

finding: BasketItem Cross-Account Update BOLA
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 / BasketItems API:3000
remediation: Enforce object ownership through the parent Basket.UserId before updating or deleting BasketItems.

finding: Password Change Does Not Require Current Password
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Require current-password reauthentication for password changes, use POST with CSRF protections, and revoke existing sessions after password changes.

finding: Adjacent Juice Shop JWT public-key/HMAC confusion
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0
remediation: Enforce explicit JWT algorithms and correct key types; remove public key exposure if not required.

finding: Exposed Premium Key Allows Unauthorized Deluxe Membership Upgrade
target: OWASP Juice Shop deluxe membership API on port 3000
remediation: Remove /encryptionkeys/premium.key from public access, rotate the key, and replace static-token upgrades with server-side payment/entitlement verification.

finding: Unauthenticated registration role mass-assignment creates admin users
target: OWASP Juice Shop / Node.js Express on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Implement server-side field whitelisting for registration and set role/customer status only on the server; audit for existing unauthorized admin accounts.

finding: Cross-instance premium.key secret reuse enables deluxe membership upgrade
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0
remediation: Rotate and scope premium keys per instance, remove public exposure, and require server-side entitlement validation.

finding: Any authenticated customer can read all user records via /api/Users
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 user API:3000
remediation: Require an administrative role for user-list APIs and restrict returned fields to the minimum required.

finding: Cross-instance JWT signing-key reuse allows admin token replay
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 on adjacent host 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Rotate JWT signing keys per instance and enforce issuer/audience binding so tokens from one host cannot authorize another.

finding: Login JWT Payload Discloses Password MD5 Hashes
target: OWASP Juice Shop JWT/session issuance on port 3000
remediation: Issue JWTs with minimal claims only, remove password/totp/deluxeToken fields from token payloads, and rotate all tokens issued with sensitive claims.

finding: JWT algorithm confusion allows forged admin tokens (alg=none and RS256→HS256)
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Pin JWT verification to the expected asymmetric algorithm, reject alg=none and HS* for RS256 tokens, rotate keys, and remove key material from public static paths.

finding: Broken Object-Level Authorization on Basket Retrieval
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Enforce object ownership checks on /rest/basket/:id and return 403 when the authenticated user does not own the basket.

finding: Unsigned alg=none JWT Accepted by General Protected API Middleware
target: OWASP Juice Shop JWT middleware on port 3000
remediation: Disable alg=none, pin JWT verification algorithms server-side, update JWT libraries/configuration, and rotate all active tokens.

finding: Unauthenticated Prometheus Metrics Exposure
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 / Prometheus metrics endpoint:3000

finding: Customer Can Create Public Product Records with Stored HTML

finding: Exposed premium.key replays to upgrade any account to deluxe membership

finding: Customer Can Modify Existing Product Records and Prices

finding: Customer Role Can Read Full User Directory

finding: Cross-instance JWT signing key reuse enables token replay
target: OWASP Juice Shop instances on 10.10.0.21:3000 and 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Use unique signing keys and issuer/audience validation per deployment; rotate reused JWT and premium keys immediately.

finding: Product Search SQL Injection

finding: Customer JWT Can Access Full Users API

remediation: Add role-based authorization to /api/Users and redact sensitive user attributes from list responses.

finding: Unauthenticated User Registration Mass Assignment to Admin Role
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 / user registration API:3000
remediation: Whitelist assignable registration fields server-side and force role/customer state independent of client input.

finding: JWT Not Revoked After Password Change
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 / JWT session management:3000
remediation: Include a per-user token version or passwordChangedAt claim in JWTs and increment it on password reset/change; shorten JWT lifetime.

finding: Exposed Premium Key Enables Free Deluxe Membership Upgrade
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 / deluxe membership API:3000
remediation: Remove premium.key from the web root and bind deluxe upgrades to server-side payment verification rather than bearer tokens.

finding: Unauthenticated Security Question Disclosure and Email Enumeration
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 / password recovery API:3000
remediation: Return uniform recovery responses, require anti-automation controls, and avoid disclosing recovery questions until the user has passed an appropriate verification step.

finding: Login JWT Payload Exposes Password Hash and Full User Model
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 / JWT session issuance:3000
remediation: Issue minimal JWT claims only, rotate existing tokens, and migrate password storage from unsalted MD5 to a modern password KDF.

finding: BasketItem Cross-Account Update BOLA
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 / BasketItems API:3000
remediation: Enforce object ownership through the parent Basket.UserId before updating or deleting BasketItems.

finding: Adjacent Juice Shop Instance Accepts Unsigned alg=none Admin JWTs
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / JWT authentication:3000

finding: Global Basket Read IDOR
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 / Basket REST API:3000
remediation: Authorize basket access by authenticated user ownership and avoid exposing arbitrary basket IDs.

finding: Unauthenticated Prometheus Metrics Exposure
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 / Prometheus metrics endpoint:3000
remediation: Restrict /metrics to authenticated administrators or an internal monitoring network and remove sensitive labels where possible.

finding: Customer Can Create Public Product Records with Stored HTML
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 / Products API:3000
remediation: Restrict product create/update/delete endpoints to administrators and sanitize/encode product fields before display.

finding: Customer Can Modify Existing Product Records and Prices
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 / Products API:3000
remediation: Restrict product updates to administrators and audit all price/catalog changes.

finding: Unauthenticated Feedback Records Exposure
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 / Feedbacks API:3000
remediation: Require authorization for raw feedback APIs or expose only curated, fully anonymized public testimonials.

finding: SQL Injection in Product Search Query
target: OWASP Juice Shop product search API on port 3000
remediation: Use parameterized queries/bind variables for search, escape LIKE metacharacters, and add regression tests for SQL metacharacter payloads.

finding: Stored Scriptable HTML Injection in Product Fields
target: OWASP Juice Shop product administration/search APIs on port 3000
remediation: Sanitize product fields on input, encode on output, disallow dangerous tags/URI schemes, and enforce CSP to reduce XSS impact.

finding: XXE Local File Disclosure in File Upload XML Parser
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 file upload on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Disable DTD/external entity resolution for XML parsing, block file/network entity access, and avoid reflecting parsed XML contents in error pages.

finding: Unauthenticated ChromaDB Exposes Vulnerability Intelligence
target: ChromaDB 0.5.18 / FastAPI on 10.10.0.1:8001
remediation: Remove public/network exposure of ChromaDB, require authentication/authorization for all collection APIs, and purge or encrypt sensitive security/session documents.

finding: Exposed JWT public key enables HS256/RS256 key-confusion admin JWT forgery
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1
remediation: Remove public access to key material and enforce a strict JWT algorithm allowlist with separate keys for asymmetric and HMAC algorithms.

finding: Exposed hardcoded premium.key grants Deluxe membership
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1

finding: Unauthenticated Prometheus metrics expose version, upload history, and operational data
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1

finding: Publicly exposed quarantine shortcut to native malware executable
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.21:3000

finding: Authentication bypass via SQL injection in login email field
target: OWASP Juice Shop Node/Express application:3000
remediation: Parameterize login queries and compare credentials only after selecting a single user by normalized email.

finding: JWT signature bypass via alg=none accepted on protected APIs
target: OWASP Juice Shop JWT authentication:3000
remediation: Configure a strict JWT algorithms allowlist and reject unsigned tokens unconditionally.

finding: JWT RS256-to-HS256 key confusion using exposed jwt.pub
target: OWASP Juice Shop JWT authentication:3000

finding: Password change does not require current password

finding: Cross-account basket IDOR/BOLA

remediation: Enforce object ownership checks on every basket access.

finding: Low-privilege users can enumerate all users via /api/Users

finding: Unauthenticated admin account creation via role mass assignment
target: OWASP Juice Shop user registration:3000

finding: Login JWT Leaks User Password Hashes
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 authentication on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Issue JWTs with minimal non-sensitive claims only, remove password/hash fields from token payloads and API serializers, and migrate password storage from MD5 to Argon2id or bcrypt with per-user salts.

finding: Unauthenticated Security Question Disclosure and Account Enumeration
target: OWASP Juice Shop authentication recovery on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Return uniform recovery responses for existing and nonexistent accounts, rate-limit recovery lookups, and avoid exposing security questions before a verified recovery step.

finding: Cross-host JWT replay enables application-layer lateral movement
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.20:3000 and 10.10.0.21:3000 using shared JWT trust material

finding: Public encrypted announcement recoverable via textbook RSA and leaked bytecode constants
target: OWASP Juice Shop static FTP artifacts on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Remove encrypted confidential artifacts and encryption bytecode from public static directories; replace textbook RSA with standard authenticated encryption or properly padded hybrid encryption.

finding: Unauthenticated Exposure of KeePass Password Vault Artifact
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 static FTP artifacts on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Remove password vaults from public web paths, require authentication/authorization for support artifacts, and rotate any credentials contained in the exposed vault.

finding: Session JWT exposes user's MD5 password hash
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 / Node.js v18.14.0
remediation: Never place password hashes or other secrets in client-visible JWT claims; issue minimal opaque/session claims and use bcrypt/argon2 for stored password hashes.

finding: Unauthenticated Prometheus Metrics Exposure
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 metrics endpoint on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Require authentication or network allow-listing for /metrics and avoid exposing business-sensitive metric labels publicly.

finding: JWT RS256-to-HS256 algorithm confusion allows forged bearer tokens
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 / Node.js v18.14.0
remediation: Pin JWT verification to RS256 only, separate asymmetric and HMAC key paths, rotate keys, and invalidate previously issued/forged tokens.

finding: JWT Sessions Remain Valid After Password Change
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 authentication/session management on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Invalidate all existing sessions/JWTs on password changes by checking token version, passwordChangedAt, or a revocation list during every authenticated request.

finding: SQL Injection Authentication Bypass Yields Admin JWT
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1
remediation: Replace string-concatenated login queries with parameterized ORM queries/prepared statements and validate login input server-side.

finding: JWT Algorithm/Key Confusion in B2B API Using Exposed Public Key
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 NextGen B2B API:3000
remediation: Pin JWT verification to RS256 with an RSA public key object, reject HS* algorithms, and prevent public key material from being usable as an HMAC secret.

finding: Authentication bypass via SQL injection in login email field
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1
remediation: Replace string-built SQL in login with parameterized queries and add regression tests for SQLi login bypass payloads.

finding: Customer Role Can Read Arbitrary User Records by ID
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 API on 10.10.0.21:3000

finding: SQL injection in login bypasses authentication and issues administrator JWT
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 / Node.js v18.14.0
remediation: Replace raw SQL string concatenation in login with parameterized queries/ORM predicates and add input validation plus regression tests for SQL metacharacters.

finding: Unauthenticated ChromaDB API Exposes Internal Session Memory
target: ChromaDB 0.5.18 / FastAPI on 10.10.0.1:8001
remediation: Require authentication for ChromaDB, restrict network exposure, and purge sensitive session data from vector collections.

finding: Unsigned JWT accepted for administrator authorization
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 JWT authorization:3000
remediation: Pin JWT verification to the expected asymmetric algorithm and reject unsigned tokens.

finding: Password changes do not invalidate existing JWT sessions
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 / Node.js v18.14.0
remediation: Track token version or passwordChangedAt per user and reject JWTs issued before password rotation; shorten token TTL and support explicit revocation.

finding: Customer JWT can read arbitrary user objects by ID
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 / Node.js v18.14.0
remediation: Enforce object-level authorization on /api/Users/{id}; allow self-only access for customers and admin-only access for other users, and return minimal public fields.

finding: B2B Order Creation via JWT RS256-to-HS256 Algorithm Confusion
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 B2B API on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Pin B2B JWT verification to RS256 only, reject HS256/none tokens, remove exposed key files from public web paths, and rotate JWT key material.

finding: Exposed JWT public key enables HS256 JWT forgery and admin API access
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 on Node.js v18.14.0
remediation: Pin JWT verification to RS256, never use public keys as HMAC secrets, and remove key files from public web paths.

finding: Exposed JWT public key enables forged B2B order authorization
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 NextGen B2B API:3000
remediation: Use asymmetric JWT verification with an explicit RS256 allow-list and remove public key files from attacker-readable locations.

finding: Hardcoded premium payment key exposed and accepted for Deluxe membership upgrade
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1

finding: Exposed JWT public key enables forged admin tokens accepted across hosts
target: OWASP Juice Shop JWT authentication on 10.10.0.20:3000 and 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Remove exposed key material, pin accepted JWT algorithms to RS256 only, enforce issuer/audience, and rotate unique per-host keys.

finding: JWT RS256-to-HS256 algorithm confusion using exposed public key
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 JWT authorization:3000
remediation: Pin JWT verification to RS256 only and remove public-key endpoints unless strictly required.

finding: Customer Role Can Dump Global Authentication Details and JWTs
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 authentication details API on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Restrict global authentication detail access to administrators, scope customer access to the subject user only, and never return raw tokens, password fields, or TOTP secrets in API responses.

finding: JWT payload leaks unsalted MD5 password hashes
target: OWASP Juice Shop authentication on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Never place password hashes or full user records in JWT claims; use minimal claims and migrate password storage from unsalted MD5 to Argon2id/bcrypt with per-user salts.

finding: Unauthenticated Admin Application Configuration Disclosure
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 admin configuration API on 10.10.0.21:3000

target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 / Node.js v18.14.0

finding: JWTs remain valid after password change
target: OWASP Juice Shop JWT session management:3000
remediation: Invalidate all existing sessions/JWTs on password change by using token versioning, revocation lists, or short-lived access tokens with refresh-token rotation.

finding: Direct user-object IDOR via /api/Users/{id}
target: OWASP Juice Shop user API:3000
remediation: Enforce per-object ownership checks for `/api/Users/{id}` and reserve arbitrary user lookup for admins only.

finding: Global authentication-details disclosure to customer users

finding: Customer-readable authentication-details leaks replayable admin JWTs

finding: Unauthenticated admin configuration disclosure

finding: JWT RS256-to-HS256 Key Confusion Using Exposed jwt.pub
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 JWT authorization middleware and B2B API:3000

finding: Customer-Readable Authentication Details Leak Global User Records and JWTs

remediation: Require strong authentication and authorization on all replica-manager endpoints, bind the service to localhost or a management network, and validate stack_pin/target_ip against an allowlist.

finding: Double-encoded null-byte FTP allowlist bypass exposes protected bytecode artifacts
target: OWASP Juice Shop HTTP:3000
remediation: Canonicalize and fully decode requested filenames before validation, reject NUL bytes, and enforce an allowlist using path.extname on the canonical basename.

finding: Unauthenticated ChromaDB permits read access to attack-session collections
target: ChromaDB/Uvicorn API:8001
remediation: Enable ChromaDB authentication, restrict network exposure to trusted service identities, and remove sensitive credentials/session data from vector-store documents.

finding: JWT RS256-to-HS256 Algorithm Confusion Using Exposed Public Key
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 JWT authorization:3000
remediation: Pin JWT verification to RS256, reject HS256/none for asymmetric tokens, rotate signing keys, and avoid exposing key material unnecessarily.

finding: Unauthenticated admin account creation via mass assignment
target: OWASP Juice Shop generated User API on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Enforce server-side allow-lists for registration fields and force role='customer' on public user creation.

finding: Open redirect due to substring allow-list matching
target: OWASP Juice Shop redirect route on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Parse and canonicalize URLs, then compare scheme/hostname/path against an exact allow-list; never use substring matching for redirects.

finding: Password reset security-answer guessing is not rate limited
target: OWASP Juice Shop password reset on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Rate-limit and lock out repeated reset-answer failures; prefer token-based reset over knowledge-based questions.

finding: FTP File Extension Filter Bypass via Double-Encoded Null Byte Suffix
target: OWASP Juice Shop /ftp file server on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Canonicalize and fully decode filenames before validation, reject null-byte encodings, enforce allow-listed extensions on the resolved path, and remove backups from the public directory.

finding: JWT alg=none authentication bypass allows admin impersonation
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 on Node.js/Express:3000
remediation: Configure JWT verification to require a fixed signed algorithm such as RS256 and explicitly reject alg=none tokens.

finding: JWT HS/RS algorithm confusion using exposed RSA public key as HMAC secret
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 on Node.js/Express:3000
remediation: Pin JWT verification to RS256 only, reject HMAC algorithms for RSA-key tokens, remove unnecessary key exposure, and rotate JWT signing keys.

finding: NoSQL JavaScript injection in order tracking
target: OWASP Juice Shop order tracking on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Never use MongoDB $where with user input; query by typed fields and validate the order id format before querying.

finding: Customer JWT can read arbitrary user records by ID
target: OWASP Juice Shop user API on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Enforce object-level authorization: non-admin users may only access their own user record and only safe fields.

finding: SQL Injection Authentication Bypass in Juice Shop Login
target: OWASP Juice Shop (Express ^4.17.1)
remediation: Parameterize the login query and reject SQL metacharacter payloads at validation boundaries.

finding: Server-Side JavaScript Evaluation in B2B orderLinesData
target: OWASP Juice Shop B2B API (Express ^4.17.1 / notevil):3000
remediation: Remove server-side eval from B2B order parsing and validate `orderLinesData` as JSON against a strict schema.

finding: Double-Encoded Null Byte Extension Filter Bypass Exposes Blocked FTP Artifacts
target: OWASP Juice Shop FTP artifact handler:3000
remediation: Canonicalize/decode paths before extension filtering and reject null bytes or encoded control characters.

finding: Unauthenticated User Role Mass Assignment Creates Administrator Accounts
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 user registration API:3000
remediation: Remove role from public mass-assignment input, default new users to customer, and enforce server-side authorization for role changes.

finding: SQL injection in login endpoint allows admin authentication bypass
target: OWASP Juice Shop Node/Express application:3000
remediation: Use parameterized queries or ORM where clauses for all login lookups and never interpolate request fields into SQL.

finding: MongoDB $where injection in order tracking
target: OWASP Juice Shop Node/Express application:3000
remediation: Remove $where usage and query by a typed, validated orderId field with strict input validation.

finding: Hardcoded RSA private key enables arbitrary RS256 admin JWT forgery
target: OWASP Juice Shop JWT authentication:3000
remediation: Remove keys from source, rotate JWT key material, store private keys in a secret manager, and invalidate all tokens signed by the exposed key.

finding: Authenticated SSRF via profile image URL upload
target: OWASP Juice Shop profile image upload:3000
remediation: Allowlist trusted external image hosts, block loopback/private/link-local addresses, enforce HTTPS, and fetch via a hardened SSRF-safe proxy.

finding: Unauthenticated XXE file disclosure in XML upload handler
target: OWASP Juice Shop file upload:3000
remediation: Disable external entity expansion and DTD loading, reject DOCTYPE declarations, and avoid returning parser output in error messages.

finding: Open redirect through substring allowlist validation
target: OWASP Juice Shop redirect route:3000
remediation: Validate redirects using parsed URL components and exact host/scheme checks; never use substring matching for allowlists.

finding: FTP Download Filter Bypass via Double-Encoded Null Byte Exposes Restricted Artifacts
target: OWASP Juice Shop / FTP file download route:3000
remediation: Canonicalize and repeatedly decode filenames before validation, reject null bytes, and enforce an allow-list on the final normalized extension.

finding: Password Change via GET Query Parameters Enables CSRF and Credential Leakage
target: OWASP Juice Shop / password change API:3000
remediation: Use POST with CSRF protection for password changes and accept secrets only in the request body over HTTPS, never in URLs.

finding: JWT Sessions Remain Valid After Password Change
target: OWASP Juice Shop / JWT session management:3000
remediation: Track token version or passwordChangedAt per user and reject JWTs issued before the latest credential change.

finding: Poison-null-byte file extension bypass exposes blocked FTP backup files
target: OWASP Juice Shop FTP file server on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Reject null bytes before any truncation, canonicalize the decoded basename, and enforce extension allow-lists on the final canonical filename.

finding: Authenticated IDOR exposes other users' records
target: OWASP Juice Shop user API:3000
remediation: Enforce per-object authorization checks on user records and avoid sequential predictable identifiers where possible.

finding: Unauthenticated GENESIS replica manager allows arbitrary replica creation for pivot staging
target: GENESIS Replica Manager (Uvicorn HTTP):3701
remediation: Require strong authentication/authorization on /replicas and /spawn, validate stack_pin and target_ip against an allowlist, and isolate the manager from attacker-reachable networks.

finding: Cross-account basket IDOR on /rest/basket/{id}
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Add server-side object ownership checks for basket resources and regression tests for cross-account IDs.

finding: Login SQL injection mints admin JWT
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Parameterize login queries, rotate sessions, and add tests for SQL metacharacters in credentials.

finding: Unauthenticated security-question disclosure enables account enumeration
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Make recovery responses generic, add throttling, and avoid exposing per-account security metadata unauthenticated.

finding: Unauthenticated registration mass assignment creates admin accounts
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Allow-list registration fields, force default role=customer server-side, and audit existing unauthorized admin accounts.

finding: Unauthenticated ChromaDB permits arbitrary collection creation and document poisoning
target: ChromaDB/Uvicorn API:8001
remediation: Enable ChromaDB authentication/authorization, firewall port 8001 to trusted backends only, and treat vector-store contents as untrusted unless integrity-protected.

finding: Zip Slip arbitrary file write via complaint upload
target: OWASP Juice Shop file upload on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Normalize ZIP entry names, enforce containment with path.relative against the intended extraction root, and reject traversal/absolute paths.

finding: Unauthenticated Prometheus metrics exposure
target: OWASP Juice Shop metrics endpoint on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Restrict /metrics to trusted monitoring networks or require authentication and authorization.

finding: Broken Access Control Exposes Global Authentication Details to Any Customer
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 authentication details API:3000
remediation: Restrict authentication-details to audited administrators only and remove secrets/tokens/TOTP fields from responses.

finding: JWT payload leaks password hash and sensitive user fields
target: OWASP Juice Shop JWT issuing logic:3000
remediation: Issue minimal JWTs and remove sensitive database fields from all token claims.

finding: JWT signature bypass enables unauthenticated administrator access
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 on Node.js v18.14.0
remediation: Pin JWT verification to RS256, reject unsigned tokens, prevent algorithm confusion, and rotate all JWT keys/sessions.

finding: Double-encoded null-byte bypass exposes blocked FTP backup artifacts
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 static /ftp artifact handler:3000
remediation: Canonicalize and fully decode filenames before extension checks; reject NUL bytes and serve files from a strict allowlist.

finding: JWT key reuse enables lateral admin-token replay to adjacent Juice Shop instance
target: OWASP Juice Shop-compatible services on 10.10.0.21:3000 and 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Rotate JWT keys per instance, pin issuer/audience, and prevent cross-service token replay.

finding: JWT RS256-to-HS256 Algorithm Confusion Enables Admin Token Forgery
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 on Node.js v18.14.0
remediation: Pin JWT verification to RS256 only, reject HS* algorithms for RSA-backed tokens, and upgrade/patch jsonwebtoken usage.

finding: Unsigned alg=none JWT Accepted for Admin Authentication
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 on Node.js v18.14.0
remediation: Disable alg=none support and explicitly allowlist only the intended signing algorithm during JWT verification.

finding: Cross-Account Basket IDOR via /rest/basket/{id}
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 on Node.js v18.14.0
remediation: Add object-level authorization checks on /rest/basket/{id} so the authenticated user id must match the basket owner.

finding: Unauthenticated User Registration Role Mass Assignment Creates Admin Accounts
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 on Node.js v18.14.0
remediation: Remove role and privileged fields from public registration input, default all self-registered users to customer, and enforce server-side role assignment only by trusted admin workflows.

finding: Client-controlled token cookie accepted as authentication source
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Remove token-cookie auth fallback or harden it as a server-issued HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite cookie with CSRF protection and JWT algorithm pinning.

finding: IDOR Allows Any Customer to Read Other Users by Numeric ID
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 user API:3000
remediation: Add per-object authorization checks so customers can only read their own user object unless explicitly admin.

finding: Unauthenticated Chromium renderer enables SSRF and file-scheme local file read
target: chromium_renderer HTTP API:3301
remediation: Require authentication on /render, allowlist schemes/hosts, block file:// and private-network destinations, and run the renderer with strict egress firewalling and least filesystem access.

finding: Unauthenticated ChromaDB API exposes internal attack-graph collections
target: ChromaDB/Uvicorn on 10.10.0.1:8001
remediation: Restrict ChromaDB network exposure and enforce authentication/authorization before allowing collection enumeration or document retrieval.

finding: Basket IDOR Allows Cross-Account Basket Disclosure
target: OWASP Juice Shop basket API on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Enforce basket ownership checks on all basket read/write routes and avoid exposing sequential basket ids where possible.

finding: Unauthenticated Zip Slip arbitrary file write via ZIP upload
target: OWASP Juice Shop file upload:3000
remediation: Normalize each ZIP entry against a fixed upload root, require startsWith(uploadRoot + path.sep), reject absolute/traversal paths, and avoid overwriting existing files.

finding: Password change is performed via GET without CSRF token
target: OWASP Juice Shop password change API:3000
remediation: Move password change to a non-GET method and require CSRF protection plus re-authentication.

finding: Leaked Premium Key Enables Unauthorized Deluxe Membership Activation
target: OWASP Juice Shop deluxe membership API on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Revoke and rotate exposed premium keys, store only hashed one-time redemption tokens, and keep key artifacts out of web-accessible locations.

finding: Customer JWT Can Enumerate All Users via /api/Users
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 on Node.js v18.14.0
remediation: Enforce role-based authorization on /api/Users so only admin users can enumerate user records.

finding: Password Change Performed via GET Without CSRF Protection
target: OWASP Juice Shop password-change endpoint on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Move password change to POST/PATCH, require CSRF protection for browser sessions, require current password reauthentication, and redact password hashes from responses.

finding: Unauthenticated ChromaDB API exposes GENESIS knowledge collections
target: ChromaDB HTTP API (Uvicorn):8001
remediation: Enable ChromaDB authentication, restrict network exposure, and treat stored GENESIS knowledge as sensitive secrets-bearing data.

finding: Unauthenticated GENESIS Replica Manager exposes state-changing management API
target: GENESIS Replica Manager 7.0.0 / Uvicorn:3701
remediation: Place Replica Manager behind authenticated admin-only access and block unauthenticated access to /spawn, /replicas, /docs, and /openapi.json.

finding: Low-Privilege Customer Can List All User Records
target: OWASP Juice Shop user API on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Restrict user listing endpoints to administrators and provide a separate self-profile endpoint for normal customers.

finding: Exposed JWT verification key enables HS256 admin JWT forgery
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 / Node.js 18.14.0
remediation: Remove public access to /encryptionkeys, rotate JWT keys, and enforce a single asymmetric JWT algorithm such as RS256 with explicit algorithm allowlisting.

finding: OpenAPI-disclosed B2B orderLinesData reaches server-side JavaScript evaluator
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 B2B API / notevil JavaScript evaluator:3000
remediation: Do not evaluate orderLinesData as JavaScript; parse it strictly as JSON and validate the schema before processing.

finding: Public /ftp artifact exposure with extension-filter bypass leaks backups and crypto clues
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 static /ftp artifact handler:3000
remediation: Disable directory listing, remove backup/bytecode/key files from the web root, and validate canonical decoded filenames against a strict allowlist.

finding: Public Socket.IO Source Map Disclosure
target: OWASP Juice Shop static Socket.IO asset on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Disable source map generation in production builds or block access to *.map files at the web server/static middleware layer.

finding: B2B Order Creation Lacks Role or Scope Authorization
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 on Node.js v18.14.0
remediation: Require an explicit B2B role/scope or dedicated OAuth client authorization for /b2b/v2/orders instead of accepting any authenticated customer JWT.

finding: Unauthenticated security-question disclosure and email enumeration
target: OWASP Juice Shop password recovery API:3000
remediation: Make account recovery responses indistinguishable for existing and nonexistent accounts and avoid unauthenticated question disclosure.

finding: Authenticated server-side JavaScript eval in profile username enables local file disclosure
target: OWASP Juice Shop profile rendering:3000
remediation: Remove eval() from profile rendering, HTML-encode usernames, and add regression tests that profile fields containing #{...} are rendered literally.

finding: Unauthenticated ChromaDB document read discloses operational attack intelligence
target: ChromaDB HTTP API (Uvicorn):8001
remediation: Require authentication for ChromaDB collection reads, restrict port 8001 to trusted backends, and scrub secrets/topology from stored documents.

finding: Broken Access Control Exposes Full User Directory to Any Customer
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 user API:3000
remediation: Require administrator role for /api/Users collection listing and return only self-scoped data to customers.

finding: Low-privilege users can harvest and replay administrator JWTs
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1
remediation: Enforce object-level authorization on authentication-details and redact all token/secret fields; revoke exposed tokens.

finding: Password Change Does Not Revoke Existing JWT Sessions
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 on Node.js v18.14.0
remediation: Track passwordChangedAt or tokenVersion server-side and reject JWTs issued before password changes; reduce JWT lifetime and add revocation support.

finding: Unauthenticated role mass assignment creates administrator accounts
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1
remediation: Remove role from public registration input, assign customer role server-side, and audit/remove illegitimate admin accounts.

finding: Login SQL injection issues administrator JWT
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1
remediation: Parameterize the login query, add regression tests for tautology payloads, and rotate sessions/tokens issued through the flaw.

finding: Customer Can Harvest and Replay Admin JWTs from Authentication Details Endpoint
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 on Node.js v18.14.0
remediation: Do not expose authentication artifacts; enforce admin-only access or current-user scoping and redact/remove all JWT/session tokens from responses.

finding: Password Change Performed via GET Without CSRF Token
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 password-change API:3000
remediation: Move password changes to POST/PATCH, require CSRF protection for browser-authenticated flows, and reject state-changing GET requests.

finding: Unauthenticated XML entity expansion parsing on /file-upload
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 file upload XML parser / libxmljs legacy dependency:3000
remediation: Disable DTD/entity processing for XML uploads, reject DOCTYPE/ENTITY declarations before parsing, and remove deprecated /file-upload functionality if no longer needed.

finding: Customer role can enumerate full user directory
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1
remediation: Enforce role checks on /api/Users collection and per-object ownership checks on user records.

finding: Security Question Endpoint Leaks Account Existence and Reset Questions
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 password-reset API:3000
remediation: Do not disclose password-reset questions before authentication; return uniform responses and rate-limit/reset via verified channels.

finding: Password change is performed via GET without CSRF token
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1
remediation: Disable GET password changes, require CSRF-protected POST/PATCH, and invalidate existing sessions after password changes.

finding: Customer-Readable Authentication Details Leak Replayable Administrator JWTs
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 authentication details API / JWT session management:3000
remediation: Remove JWT/session material from API responses, restrict the endpoint to admins, rotate JWT keys, and invalidate all exposed tokens.

finding: JWTs are not revoked after password change
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1
remediation: Invalidate all existing JWTs/session tokens on password change and add server-side token revocation/version checks.

finding: Security-question endpoint leaks account existence and reset questions
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1
remediation: Normalize responses for existing/nonexisting accounts, rate-limit recovery endpoints, and avoid exposing reset-question content before identity verification.

finding: Unauthenticated SQL Injection in Login Mints Admin JWT
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Use parameterized queries or ORM query builders for login lookups and reject SQL metacharacter payloads only as defense-in-depth.

finding: JWT Key Confusion via Exposed Public Key and Unsafe Verification
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Pin JWT algorithms to RS256, never use public keys as HMAC secrets, remove public directory listing for encryption keys, and rotate JWT signing keys.

finding: Unauthenticated XXE File Disclosure in XML Upload
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Disable DTD/external entity resolution, prevent network/entity loading, and avoid reflecting parsed XML or parser errors to clients.

finding: Unauthenticated MongoDB $where JavaScript Injection in Track Order
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Remove $where and query by structured fields only; sanitize route parameters regardless of deployment environment.

finding: SQL injection authentication bypass in Juice Shop login
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.21:3000

finding: JWT alg=none signature bypass permits arbitrary admin tokens

remediation: Configure JWT verification to allow only RS256 with the configured public key and reject alg=none/unsigned tokens.

finding: Cross-instance JWT key confusion enables admin access to adjacent Juice Shop
remediation: Pin JWT verification to RS256 only, reject alg=none/HS256 for RSA keys, rotate per-environment keys, and stop exposing signing material through web paths.

finding: Unauthenticated GENESIS Replica Manager topology disclosure
target: GENESIS Replica Manager uvicorn API:3701
remediation: Enforce authentication/authorization on replica-management endpoints and redact compose_dir/session metadata from normal responses.

finding: JWT alg=none accepted allows unsigned admin token forgery
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.21:3000

finding: Customer-accessible authentication details leak replayable admin JWTs
target: OWASP Juice Shop authentication details API on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Limit authentication-detail records to admin-only use and remove/redact token fields from all API responses.

finding: Server-side JavaScript injection and local file read in order tracking
target: OWASP Juice Shop on Node.js v18.14.0
remediation: Remove $where/new Function evaluation and query by a validated orderId value using a safe equality filter.

finding: SQL injection authentication bypass returns admin JWT
target: OWASP Juice Shop authentication API:3000
remediation: Use ORM/parameterized queries for login and validate email input; never concatenate credentials into SQL.

finding: JWT alg=none acceptance enables unsigned admin token forgery
target: OWASP Juice Shop JWT authorization:3000
remediation: Pin accepted JWT algorithms to RS256/expected algorithms only and reject alg=none or unsigned tokens.

finding: Customer-readable authentication history leaks replayable admin JWTs

finding: Security question endpoint leaks account existence and reset question

finding: Null-byte extension bypass downloads restricted /ftp binary artifact

remediation: Canonicalize and validate filenames after decoding, reject null bytes, and serve only allowlisted extensions by basename.

finding: JWT alg=none admin token accepted
target: OWASP Juice Shop Node/Express on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Use a strict JWT verifier with an explicit algorithms allow-list and reject unsigned tokens.

finding: SQL injection in login grants admin JWT

finding: Broken authorization exposes full user directory and admin user object to customers
target: OWASP Juice Shop user API on 10.10.0.21:3000

finding: Customer-readable authentication-details leaks replayable admin JWTs
target: OWASP Juice Shop Node/Express on 10.10.0.21:3000

target: OWASP Juice Shop Node/Express on 10.10.0.21:3000

target: OWASP Juice Shop Node/Express on 10.10.0.21:3000

finding: Customer-readable authentication-details leaks replayable admin JWTs
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Restrict authentication-details to the current user, remove JWT/token material from responses, and invalidate exposed tokens immediately.

finding: JWT alg=none signature bypass enables forged admin tokens
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.21:3000
remediation: Pin JWT verification to RS256, reject alg=none/unexpected algorithms, and use a maintained JWT library with explicit algorithms.

finding: Broken authorization exposes user directory and admin configuration to customer JWTs
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.21:3000

finding: JWTs remain valid after password change

finding: SQL Injection Authentication Bypass in Login

finding: FTP Allowlist Bypass Exposes Backup and Binary Artifacts
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 static /ftp artifact handler:3000

target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 JWT authorization middleware and B2B API:3000

finding: MongoDB $where Server-Side JavaScript Injection in Track Order

finding: Customer-Accessible Authentication Details Leak Replayable Admin JWTs
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 authentication details API:3000

finding: Unauthenticated Prometheus Metrics Disclosure

finding: Unauthenticated MarsDB $where Server-Side JavaScript Injection Enables Arbitrary File Read/Write
target: OWASP Juice Shop 14.5.1 on 10.10.0.21:3000

finding: RS256-to-HS256 JWT algorithm confusion using exposed public key
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.21:3000

finding: JWTs remain valid after password change

finding: Unauthenticated application configuration disclosure
